title: Love this pillow cover!
text: Love this pillow cover!. I've been a fan of Charles Wysocki's art for many years, and I also collect mice in various forms, so this pillow is perfect!  The cat is what's noticed first but the mouse peeking out from the shelf below is the main reason I bought this - along with the amusing book titles like "Field Guide to the Garbage Can", "The Little Brown Mouse" and others.  It's not a soft pillow cover, but it's ideal for the chair where I've placed it!
